summary: Reconciled each case's expected behavior against existing run receipts and reports. Evidence supports several exact fixture outcomes and one successful real release, but mode-specific runtime gaps and incomplete fixture assertions remain. No acceptance status in inventory was changed.

applicability.EXT-F-0001: Build identity, extension reload, content-script refresh, and worker/offscreen recovery are infrastructure behaviors independent of authentication. The runtime identity retained after reload is still mode-specific, so guest, ordinary-member, and admin observations are recorded separately below. An admin observation cannot stand in for member behavior.
applicability.EXT-F-0002: Resource admission and process ownership are host-level and authentication-independent. The guest/member/admin duplicates in current result entries do not represent three distinct product roles. Keep role cells unverified or resolve their applicability at the inventory owner; shared scratch evidence should not be counted three times.
applicability.EXT-F-0003: Release validation and publication are authentication-independent infrastructure. The guest/member/admin duplicate fixture results do not demonstrate three identity-specific behaviors. They should be interpreted as one fixture outcome; release real-run evidence is also shared across modes.
